ADANIPORTS, 1 Apr – 30 Jun 2026 — Strategy 2 + B200 + ADX30

One stock, one quarter, all timeframes, delivery buys, intra-candle sell, FYERS charges only, ₹1,00,000 per trade. Education, not investment advice. Every trade with ADX, +DI/−DI, 200 average and its slope: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY2_WINDOW_ADANIPORTS_20260401_20260630_REPORT.md (script experiments/strategy2_window.py ADANIPORTS 2026-04-01 2026-06-30, reusable for any stock and dates).

Rules

Buy at a candle's close when: last 5 candles closed above the 200-candle average · ADX(14) > 30 · MACD histogram bigger than the previous candle · Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange with blue below 50. Extra versions: +DI (+DI above −DI), +SLOPE (200 average higher than 10 candles ago). Sell the moment blue crosses below orange inside a candle.

ADANIPORTS in this window: ₹1,385.40 → ₹1,810.20 (+30.7%), a strong uptrend (its 200-day uptrend started 8 Apr 2026).

  • Every timeframe made a small profit, but much less than holding the stock. Buy-and-hold of ₹1L on 1 Apr made about +₹30,000 after charges. The best single timeframe made ₹3,023; all five together made ₹8,399.
  • Why: the Stoch exit sells after a few candles (15 minutes to 3 days), so it catches small pieces of a big move. The best trade (30-min, bought ₹1,630.30 on 30 Apr, sold ₹1,708.40 on 4 May, +₹4,476) was the one that happened to be held over a gap up.
  • +SLOPE changed nothing: the 200 average was rising the whole time, so every trade already passed it.
  • +DI removed 9 trades and ₹4.5k of profit. Several good buys came on pullbacks (−DI above +DI), the same pattern as the 4-hour Nifty 50 result in strategy2_ma_adx_nifty50.md.
  • Daily: no trades. On daily ADX was above 30 on only 1 of 60 days in the window.
  • 24 trades on one stock over three months is far too few to judge the strategy. The Nifty 50 tests are the real evidence.
